summary: A January 1963 newspaper report says a State Forestry Service tower was to go up on Edwards Road, Fort Pierce. Later history and the present site are not in sources found.

events.note: Planned in January 1963: tower already on hand, to go up on a 400-foot-square lot on Edwards Road

corrections.why: The only source gives 400 feet as the size of the lot the tower was to stand on, not the tower's height. 121.9 m is 400 feet converted to metres.

evidence.supports: a State Forestry Service fire tower was to go up on a 400-foot-square lot on Edwards Road, January 1963
evidence.quote: The State Forestry Service fire tower will soon go up on a 400-foot-square lot on Edwards Rd.

evidence.supports: the newspaper report is credited to The News Tribune
the tower was already on hand and would go up once the site was ready
evidence.quote: as soon as it is ready the tower, now on hand, will go up

evidence.supports: the lot was deeded to the state agency by the county commissioners
evidence.quote: deeded to the state agency by the St. Lucie County Commissioners

evidence.supports: shop and office space were planned on the land
evidence.quote: in addition to the tower, shop and office space will be built on the land now

evidence.supports: two residences were planned on a lot near the county barn on Oleander Avenue
evidence.quote: the service plans to build two residences on the lot adjacent to the county barn location on Oleander Ave.

evidence.supports: the Forestry Service was in its second year of fire prevention, reporting and fighting work in St. Lucie County
evidence.quote: The Forestry Service is in the second year of its fire prevention, reporting and fighting service in St. Lucie County

notes_for_editor: The height correction is inferred: 400 ft is 121.92 m, so the record's 121.9 m appears to be the lot size converted, not a tower height. The only source is a 1963 plan, not a record that the tower was built, so the event is 'other', not 'built'. The quoted article is reprinted on Forest Lookouts; the original was not found. A web search for Edwards Road tower records and St. Lucie County forestry history found nothing usable. Confidence is medium for the 1963 plan and low for anything after it.
